headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a 15-1 victory, led by Tyler Tolbert's 5-hit performance, including a home run and 2 RBIs. The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, thanks to José Caballero's 2 home runs and 4 RBIs, while Cam Schlittler pitched 8 strong innings with 8 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Max Rajcic, a right-handed pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness. Other players on the injured list include Martín Pérez (Atlanta Braves), Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers), Tomoyuki Sugano (Colorado Rockies), Seth Halvorsen (Colorado Rockies), Matt Gage (San Francisco Giants), Ha-Seong Kim (Atlanta Braves), and Jakob Junis (Texas Rangers).

The New York Mets made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash consideration. The Mets also acquired right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go from the Minnesota Twins in a separate trade.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Phillies 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a lopsided 15-1 victory. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with a 5-hit performance, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, led by José Caballero's impressive performance at the plate. Caballero hit 2 home runs and drove in 4 runs, while Cam Schlittler pitched 8 strong innings with 8 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall Short in Thrilling 11-12 Loss to Nationals**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals edged out the Houston Astros 11-12 in a high-scoring game, with CJ Abrams leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Enyel De Los Santos pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief, striking out 2 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 7-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought win against the Atlanta Braves, outlasting their opponents 7-6. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a pair of home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, effective retroactive to July 4, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The deal was made for cash consideration.
